public.landing.title: Save it, don’t waste it.
public.landing.lead: With foodsharing you pick up surplus food from businesses near you and share it – voluntarily, free of charge and together with many others.
public.landing.value1Text: Bakeries, shops and restaurants give us what they can no longer sell.
public.landing.value2Text: Saved food goes to you, your neighbours or a community fridge.
public.landing.value3Text: Thousands of volunteers across Switzerland – we show you step by step how it works.
public.explainer.journeyLead: Eight steps, most of them online. You always see where you stand.
public.explainer.regionLead: Enter your postcode and see the next introductory dates.
public.explainer.faq.what.a: You pick up food from businesses that would otherwise be thrown away and pass it on.
public.explainer.faq.cost.a: No. foodsharing is voluntary and free – money never changes hands.
public.explainer.faq.time.q: How much time do I need?
public.explainer.faq.time.a: You can get started within a few weeks. After that you decide how often you pick up.
public.explainer.faq.who.a: Anyone aged 18 or over who is reliable and wants to save food.
public.explainer.faq.safe.a: Yes. The learning pages and the quiz teach you the key hygiene rules.
public.explainer.businessText: Would you like us to save your food? We pick up reliably and free of charge.
